主要内容: Novavax, Inc. (the “Company”) executed a modification to Project Agreement No. 01, dated July 6, 2020, with Advanced Technology International (“ATI”), increasing the funding available for payment and allotted to the Project Agreement by $147,349,805. The total funding now available is $1,747,689,328. The modification relates to the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium and the former Operation Warp Speed partnership.
